answer: Stop sybils with an oasis sonnet meter: an agent stakes a bond for one oasis plot. Each cycle it wanders one route and files a sonnet whose meter encodes its work; verifiers void a sonnet whose meter breaks, is copied, or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 plots at 17x cost each: each sonnet fits one oasis plot and one cycle, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents wander once and keep rights.
